name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (graphics/composite domain). Name accurately reflects the logic: composite (paint) all alive party-member chars onto the battle render workspace, plus a trailing shadow/tile-cleanup pass. No Ghidra address residue in the name. No domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Paint all alive party-member sprites onto the battle render workspace (per-char layer), then run the drop-shadow/tile-cleanup pass.
logic_summary: Stack-probe __CHK(0xC) prologue. Loops i = 0..data_fd2_battle_party_member_count-1; for each slot that is NOT dead (fd2_check_char_is_dead(i)==0) calls fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos(i) to blit that char sprite (facing + status icons). After the loop, calls fd2_paint_chars_shadow_overlay() once for the final drop-shadow / animated-tile cleanup pass. void return.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is rendering the char layer into the battle render workspace.
